newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Decrane started outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Decrane started outperform.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc said it started coverage of Decrane Aircraft Holdings Inc with an outperform rating.
-- Schroder was the lead underwriter of the company's initial public offering in April.
-- Shares were up 1/8 to 11-7/8 in late morning trading. Earlier in the session, they touched a new high of 12-1/4.
-- The stock is off compared to its initial public offering price of $12 a share.
